notes.title: Intermediate Update
notes.content:
Hi, and thanks for your patience. I will quickly present you the content of the new Intermediate update.

[b]1 Preset[/b] : 
[list]
[*]Ganges Valley
[i]Rich but already contested farmlands in the Indian subcontinent [/i]
[/list]

[b]2 Challenges [/b]: 
[list]
[*] Ashoka's Dream
[i] Led the first unification of India as the Maurya Empire[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/0d0cc46a3d96b6321357c4571cc54f3e7e3c3a04.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/9d3b3427daac6c4368b3c9bbd478e3f3bf3464c2.png[/img][/url]
[*] The Mughal Empire
[i]Try to conquer and maintain a multi-cultural and multi-confessional empire[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/5011dc80e9ea07aa7bfb8662f71797952c5e6d0f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/fabf2ee088f479e62ee3f97a26ab40ffa9f41e49.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[b]11 new Nodes[/b] :
[list]
[*] Lever: Roads (Bronze Age)
[i]Improve your trade early on by improving your road systems[/i]
[*] Lever: Paper (Feudal Age)
[i]Must have for a good bureaucracy, provide Political Power income[/i]
[*] Lever: Printing Press (Discovery Age)
[i]A path for better enlightenment, provide Political Power income[/i]
[*] State: Devastation (Discovery Age)
[i]Staying too long at war even winning will hurt your economy, produce discontent and destroy your stability[/i]
[*] Lever: War Economy (Discovery Age)
[i]Gear your economy to secure Military Supplies for your wars, but can be very costly[/i]
[*] Lever: National Parks (Industrial Age)
[i]A new method to contain pollution and generate tourism[/i]
[*] State: Civil Aviation (Industrial Age)
[i]Generate trade and air technologies by itself, will produce global warming[/i]
[*] Lever: Modern Medias (Atomic Age)
[i]Make your Propaganda and your Culture reach new levels[/i]
[*] State: Air Trade (Atomic Age)
[i]A whole new market to conquer for your products[/i]
[*] Lever: Computers (Atomic Age)
[i]Must have to improve your industry efficiency and further mechanization[/i]
[*] Lever: Combat Drones (Atomic Age)
[i]Use your powerful industry and technology to give birth to the mightiest army[/i]
[/list]

New balancing and various fixes, especially for War, Trade, Education, Conscription and Bureaucracy.
The migration mechanic was improved by the inclusion of a Humidity and Soil Fertility data maps. 

[b]Engine [/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]A new user-custom designed alert system available in game[/b]
[*] Add error message for missing bookmark era
[*] Fix double initialization node events
[*] Add link injection for modding
[*] Add node grid snap (use CTRL in a node group)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/633aa15ff0ac7d99119aa31be56578387c262c43.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/aaa4e20620455cb7e0f2ef03d58b2e506211677d.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/75702960972401697e534f5a8e7eaaeb15e3468e.png[/img]
Our next game, Legio Ad Signa left the conceptual phase, and is currently entering the prototype phase. We still currently target January 2023 for finishing the prototype. 

For sake of clarity, Orbi Universo Team does not stop developing Orbi Universo and will still support the game and add additional content, it’s just not our main project anymore.

That will be all for today. See you all next time!

notes.title: Atomic Age Update
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to this new update of Orbi Universo, which covers the Atomic Era matching roughly our 1920s to 1990s, and brings official ending points to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/b782c6539e5522b9376332f9436ff3ae41102965.png[/img]

The most important addition is the Atomic warfare system. You can now build a nuclear arsenal to have a decisive edge over any enemy but be careful not to end the world in the process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/46b859cdbe3d0f6db7844d7800e8a4a22091d355.png[/img]

[b]Atomic Warfare[/b] will change World Tension to Cold War Tension, with its own means to limit it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/43a7dd7e5edde9ed9b0ddd6df4f8390cf00d1f5b.png[/img]

The [b]Fascists [/b]will eventually pop up especially under Revanchism. They can start their own Civil War and power grab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/724f5f01f85118caabfc91a9e5ca0d7213dd27e2.png[/img]

[b]Factories now have an Efficiency node[/b], you should better develop your Electricity network, Mechanization and not pass too many laws that slows it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/caf70b37237a67b109e82c2b141ce2cca4e6e3ee.png[/img]

Pollution, Global Warming, and Health-related nodes were added as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/2aecc5bf7977c4f0c32d93cba51a51016200452c.png[/img]

If you are not currently doing a challenge, [b]4 endings of the games are now available[/b].
Hegemonic Victory will require that you triumph over your rival.
Conquest Victory will require an indecent amount of land to conquer.
Space Victory will require you to win the Space Race against your rival.
Economic Victory will require you to build an industry so large you can manipulate the world's entire market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6667d301670de3fb64d1d680f491ad0e57ae241b.png[/img]

After reaching an ending you can stop there or continue playing. You can even try to fulfill several endings in the same game.

[b]A new cache system[/b] will allow even faster loading times, we hope it will help the few people who have loading issues. Please turn it off in the settings if you want to mod the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/dfd4464b828464539fe117aca059fe4032df50d5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/e9e6e2682648b0433a290b3e310a9daf9000ade2.png[/img][/url]   [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/9debda8b820801fbe370f155716649c58cc3fa5e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/d2c1a665eddbb509eb8972e918658662df05230c.png[/img][/url]

A new challenge in the USA was added, starting in 1929. Triumph over the Great Depression, WW2 and reach the moon! 
And of course, to keep things balanced, another one: recreate their arch-rival, the Soviet Union.

Other additions have been made and I'll just cover the basics here as usual.

As stated before, the base game price will be increased from $14.99 to $19.99 in February 2022 (for reference to our other main currencies, price will go up as €16.99 and ¥1999). 

Reaching the modern era was a dream when we started the project as a student project.
This last big update will probably be the last one of Orbi Universo. It’s been 2 years of continuous updates that gradually fleshed out the game. We will still support the game, releasing hotfixes and all, but we will stop providing new content to focus on our new game.

Speaking of which.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a640f1b919bc4ee26368682052be69f48bf9aab3.png[/img]
(temporary logo)
[b]Legio Ad Signa[/b] is a historical tactical game. It recreates ancient warfare battlefields with a graphically minimalist, non-arcade and in-depth systems approach. You play as a general from Rome or their enemies in the midst of a battle, up to 200k soldiers simulated at the same time. Your role is to organize and lead your army until your enemies rout, and unlike most other games of this style, it will heavily focus on the simulation aspect in which the hierarchy of armies, partially autonomous officers and the non-immediateness of orders are the rule.

Legio is our new game in development currently in pre-prototype step. Our planning schedule is to finish a prototype in 1 year to release it as Early Access in late 2022 or early 2023. Finished game will include a campaign mode depicting the most famous Roman wars from -280 to -45, a free battle mode against AI, a scenario editor and, depending on technical challenges, a 1vs1 multiplayer mode. Available nations will include Pre-Marian and Post-Marian Rome, Carthage, Greeks and Celts.

We will disclose more information about it along the year.

notes.title: Intermediate Update
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to this small update of Orbi Universo, which brings a lot of small amelioration to the current eras, major design fixes on Nomads and also a lot of Quality of Life improvements. 

The most important change is the Nomads rework. A lot of balancing was made, including access to Late Antiquity and Feudal Age eras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/c9874ab1d9160a6e13093d15307d54091f6c0956.png[/img]

With now a proper smooth transition to a sedentary civilization. Once the time is right, just buy the Settlement node. Land, Tributaries and Authority will be converted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/2ef3e73e0d631bedf84d16140d65c1858e3410ea.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/5e22ffc6bc5fcdcb48a145c3d38ef6dd8bd6f3af.png[/img]

Military Techs were reworked, and it's now a calculated value, not a flow one. It was also balanced with a rational approach. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/9ace96573a10ebc720c95c37fde825e08b516abf.png[/img]

A small node package concerning Women's rights (Vote Rights, Emancipation laws, Requisition for Workforce etc..) was included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6fa1b74c40022db5a503b9a24b6a69579f67cf47.png[/img]

WASD/ZQSD support, Zoom rework, and other features were added and bugs were fixed, including an update of the Unity Engine version.

5 new challenges (Athens, Ottomans, Viking Age, Swedish Empire and Meiji Jidai) were added as well as many new achievements for regular games.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/d0f4a4f65e3b4e8df9e60791a5d7308812bc8744.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a549d5c1cfde05493d86e14f078dae2a8f6128f1.png[/img][/url]][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/bed5d46246f6069769f7a21c98afa807463842da.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/32cc2a6cb0d8042a2e0e1c521c0c84b71f334d7c.png[/img] [/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/28c7bbe5320b22269a7036a68a30ebef2c3aa5ca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/12cb6ae9094c102bd1e7462f3c9d9328d4758ee1.png[/img] [/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/668730f7b01ede40bcff08157ab17e57e6a95f18.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/12ba2b3805dbf3009ff1c159efe6d4808fe178c3.png[/img] [/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/15803682cd7a2195cf669bce1d972e700aadb0ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/b30c31146cdb1d0067978a85646e9171a8267e4c.png[/img] [/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/ac8b64bdfc9c1acba5a3d334fefd98111112b253.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a1836632163dce632c59c4a0ed9be96486cf3486.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/4a6e7288cc194e2f913a7fbc4ea6c48ebed1edd9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/32a2fcf74c45a3ddeba50d48f5d65d3635cf5ba1.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/148ceaec8cb6b91abaaad75abb27324510e7ce1f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6bad38e98bc3b1a519b2685f94f5bf972af0f10c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/e8004cbf26b5e7b2e3da51e930af65ba329a2afc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/252d09f441da772ea68d358c9d134b0143194d99.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/9532d5218ae176060eba860e490b652d09ad1c57.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/dd76d4823605449bfaadc8e95274a3d70b379264.png[/img][/url]

A Dark mode is currently under design and will probably be released in January alongside the Atomic update.


To be noted, the game price will be slightly increased from $14.99 to $19.99 in February 2022 (for reference to our other main currencies, price will go up as €16.99 and ¥1999 ). 
This reflects the addition of huge chunks of content and features over the past 2 years, and our choice to not make DLC to prioritize a complete game. 
Thank you for your continuous support and feedback that contributed to improve our ambitious project.


That's all for this time, see you in January 2022 for the 2 years anniversary of Orbi Universo with the big 2.0 patch containing the Atomic Era.

notes.title: Industrial Age Update
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to this new update of Orbi Universo, which covers the Industrial Era matching roughly our 1820s to 1920s. This is an important update adding no less than 80 new nodes and new mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/4002a7a40cda3ce4938ece3cd6ca3fa8a57bf2fc.png[/img]
The new heart of your civilization is Industry. Discover the steam engine, then push it to 50 and beyond to start your first factories. Maintain the flow of raw materials and secure a workforce with large cities to generate a large flow of manufactured goods for trade, civilian use or war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/0a588a8eedf274e62a0c39fcac5dcb1a6909cc63.png[/img]
Technological advancement allows you to unlock modern Agriculture and Medicine. Together, they enable what is known in history as the demographic transition, allowing your population to boom.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/dc0b44a4684ac765c1887d2829eabe6e1ad25469.png[/img]
The arrival of an Upper or Lower House will create the Parliament. Parliament is elected at regular intervals according to the popularity of the various ideologies among Conservatism, Reactionarism, Liberalism, Socialism and Communism. A lower house tends to reflect the interests of the people, while the upper house tends to favor the interests of the elites, especially conservative and reactionary ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/fd515807c7586a18f7a9ad466b48403500ab6e40.png[/img]
The party elected to power will have control over some of your nodes depending on its party type. Conservatives will prevent you from downgrading religion, liberals will prevent you from passing restrictive trade measures, reactionaries will want to keep a strong military... etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/3970c0a93fc12aaf1725730337ebc9f0987aaa79.png[/img]
Industry will create a working class, historically favorable to unionism and Marxist ideas. It is important to quickly contain working class discontent if you don't want to see your parliament covered with socialists and communists who could even start a civil war if you show a sign of weakness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/9112c498b6fe0fbfa21ff29e1a688568d6e2d6cb.png[/img]
You are not alone in this world. With the industrial revolution, a rival to world hegemony appears with attributes of its own, such as size, army, fleet and industry. If the world tension rises too high, expect a world war against this merciless rival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/c2de9f732212f757e21f158bbae706a50ce3adaa.png[/img]

A new screen is available by clicking above the speed buttons. It will show you some information about your current era but also hints on how to proceed to the next one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/d7b578216f871f7ac5e2791015a374640ab53e95.png[/img]
If you didn't notice it on the previous screenshots, the nodes can now have different sizes. While there is a default setting to help you understand the importance of some nodes over others, you can change it at any time. Your change will be common to all your games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/1fd41b762878d576652f9e5fb921f31e63d28c22.png[/img]
A new type of window has appeared. Some nodes, like Military Efficiency or Devotion will now show you how they calculate their value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a2ec868e92dffc207108c1167274e3a409c87433.png[/img]
Finally, a small button now allows you to save and load a node group template, so that you don't have to redo the same groups again and again if you keep your habits in your different games.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/615ebcd65a4a93a79c092f086ff5301d3dd75f39.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/09b86bfe0a4e2443a7c8990e104de5af8929459e.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/2b1450274aa8341c90d4ee184b1703422889be0b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/57749bc1d12a53e0ae847900b66b32552d32f2c7.png[/img][/url]

The update comes with 2 new Challenges, one in the United States, another in the British Empire, each one at a different moment of the industrial era, allowing you to test the new features as soon as possible if you wish.

Other additions have been made and I'll just cover the basics here, we've also fixed some bugs, translation errors and done a lot of balancing. On the other hand, we are aware that a small percentage of players (about 0.5%), experience an unreasonably slow launch due to under-qualified hardware. Despite several researches and attempts on our part, we still don't have any other solutions for the moment, but we are still looking for a solution.

That's all for this time, see you in January 2022 for the 2 years anniversary of Orbi Universo with hopefully a big 2.0 patch containing the Atomic Era.

notes.title: Imperialism era
notes.content:
Citoyens et citoyennes Bonjour

We are proud to finally release the new expansion of Orbi Universo, the Age of Imperialism!

[previewyoutube=6PyI6sdH4wQ;full][/previewyoutube]

(Trailer made by a fan, yes the same)

As I said before the expansion is focused on the beginning of the modern era but it's not the only new features, first we will explore the novelties on the previous era

[h2]Overhaul of previous era[/h2]

[h3]The allies[/h3]
The allies can be acquired thanks to diplomacy and they participate in wars to help you win, they will damage enemy forces and push the balance in your favour, but beware they can be unreliable.
 
[h3]Two new social classes[/h3]

[b]The Bourgeoisie[/b]
Appear when the player unlocks the guilds in the Middle Ages, they will give a huge boost at your empire trades. The more your civilization is urbanized the more they will increase in number and influence.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/26c34cda8109682c89d41fa932bc57253d285d8f.png[/img]

[b]The Peasantry[/b]
Appear when around the middle ages when the player unlocks mill
They will increase the output of agriculture.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/7d420bdf34bed59a36468f6a90fe099e139661ca.png[/img]

[b]Colonial interactions[/b]
The time where the colony were a separated world, now you can assist their development at the cost of monthly cash and political power, this will accelerate their growth and lower their autonomy desire
On the other end when the risqué of a revolt in the colonies is too high you also can use your mighty fleet to crush the revolution by your colonial Iron fist 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/b559a1a62a04431e2c440c617efc8cba4dc22e17.png[/img]
 
[b]Barbarian Threat[/b]
This Node will indicate how close you are to have Barbarian at the gate and so to the late antiquity. It helps to be better prepared for this era
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/8820607eb334aebd6c2c84746ee98ed67922e25f.png[/img]


[h2]The Imperialist era[/h2]
Of course, you are here for the new era the imperialist era, this era is full of changes that can be considered a break with the feudal ways. The revolutions and mostly the consideration that the people have something to say.
The imperialist era is unlocked with the apparition of [b]Coalition or Hostile Coalition[/b], both will spawn if the player got advanced technology like [b]Musket[/b], [b]ManOfWar[/b], or a hight[b] School of thought[/b].

The [b]Coalition[/b] spawn if you are a small state (less than 150 of state size and with a neighborhood rise is high
As long as this node is present both the neighborhood bellicism and the allies nodes get a very high boost.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/36e0c7bb26ca4c7d0429d881c87167a2fa23eacc.png[/img]

The [b]Hostile coalition[/b] represents a group of smaller countries that band together put you down. It spawns if you are a large state, more than 150 or more than 300 ColonialState.
As long as this node is present the neighborhood bellicism get a very high boost
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/5a7aaec0b5959617543ede767aa1a5cc1eee3fc7.png[/img]

This situation gives a long period of the game where you will be in a state of war, brace yourself.

[h3]The Revolution[/h3]
The Revolution and how to deal with or against it is of course one of the main focus of this era

How the Revolution 
->	It can happen if you have been in the imperialist era and there is no coalition going one
->	If you tax to munch your population they will revolt and possibly fire the ideal of the revolution
->	If the neighborhood is agitated it can spread the revolution ideal and maybe fire a revolution in your country
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/045755eb54740fcf884a1deba3e56bc4d05379e4.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to the beginning of modern politics![/b]
In this era, you have two factions that oppose themselves
The [b]Revolution Ideal[/b] is the representation of the attachment of the ideal of the revolution by your people. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6fa18a448d0ecb03e0a2031f7574d700045a05b4.png[/img]

[b]Reactionnairsm[/b] is the opposition to the revolution and the defense of the old regime They are mostly growing by your clergymen and in the reaction to the revolutionary reforms  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/434b789c8bb60e9141c66f8c0ff652295591ce56.png[/img]

Both organize revolt and seek to size powers if they are influential enough and without the appropriate regime, [b]Monarchy[/b], and derivated for the [b]Reactionary [/b] or a [b]Republic [/b] for the [b]Revolutionary[/b]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/7ff7a3b4bf448e58f05bec9a238d62631585f186.png[/img]

[h3]Republican reform[/h3]

[b]Abolition of slavery[/b]
Free all the slaves of your civilization

[b]Abolition of serfdom[/b]
They have only one value, this will boost the agricultural output but lower your capacity to tax them.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/406e2eb8ac2de106299f1854fa6c74d77801490b.png[/img]

[b]Revocation of the privileges[/b]
Will slowly decay the nobility and increase the numbers of bourgeois
It will also make the number of reactionaries explode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/387c0c5764f3905051fb1840da3da275d0be5271.png[/img]


[b]Dealing with the old world[/b]
To have a perennial republic you will have to deal with the reaction:

By sapping their main source of growing the clergy, [b]Secularization [/b]of the society will lower the growth of the reactionaries by the priest and lowering the religiosity of your civilization  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/063f17802d34da681c62958396996a335bae5113.png[/img]

By promoting the [b]politic of terror[/b], it will kill part of your people and make sure nobody will ever trouble the republic any more 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/8645c34225608c399020743e586157d9fec9b71e.png[/img]
It will violently decrease  your stability and damage your population but ...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/77337af1ccbf51c25feebde87b80eb2e97e8e956.png[/img]
...worth it

[h3]General Politics[/h3]
[b]Constitution[/b]
Available with you have writing and a high school of thought, it increases by a lot the max of political power you can accumulate
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/dd5064cdd60b7838b17b54dc3cbc4d41a6a2e526.png[/img]

[h2]Bookmarks[/h2]

In addition to all these new nodes, we are proud to present a new feature the bookmarks.
They present themselves as advanced starting positions that put you in charge of a historical situation and a set of challenges to complete.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/f73021633fd49ce01d2d7f7b4e8c7fe38cbab512.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/7bb6380da95e47e641da142a22dbf4de4bc95468.png[/img]

There are 16 Bookmarks can you achieve them all?

Thanks for your patience with you want to talk to us please feel free to join our discord: https://discord.gg/xybj94J

notes.title: Nomads Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after a long time without any updates, there is a small update.

Let's dig in it!

The previous version of the nomads was not very complete. To fix that we come up with more organic evolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/219eb1f2089d803c36640d68d04cea8c6dd36c20.jpg[/img]

Now you will have to manage the clans. Clan increase with a large population. Clans will deplete natural resources. You will have to fight them or buy them to federalize them and lead them to a common objective and limit their negative impacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/b425de7edec7190ffe610b9dbc30ea315748c32b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a940f5d6718c150cc14f16441b199f3c696234bb.jpg[/img]

You'll also have to manage steppe land and tributaries, the main factor of power as a nomadic tribe. Both are gain in war but, lands will give you more space to your livestock and gaining more food. Tributaries bring wealth but must be guarded closely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/474c8de79244239e065af0d07900f0d5fe69c9d0.jpg[/img]

Besides, we change the way migration work and is now way more playable and funny to play.

In addition we bring some technological nodes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/9bfe17dae8500c9d3e823438e224321844c34ea4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Middle ages update
notes.content:
Hi everyone. 
As promised, we released the Medieval Update. In addition to bringing a new era and the flavour that goes with it. It reshapes and brings some flavour to faith. We will review the important enhancements and the new content in this patch note.

----- Clergy and Faith updated -----

The clergy had an influence a bit loose in comparison of what it was in history. So we wanted to bring a bit more flavour to this part.

Now the clergy will have both a religious head that can be separated from the head of state and a power structure. Reform of your faith will be way more efficient if your clergy is centralized and under your control. Once you achieved that you will be able to do anything with your faith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/1f38f2a81c4d7cba9587bd37e4e9710d433ba18f.png[/img]

In addition to the structure of the clergy, religion is a set of rules and emphasis on certain aspect, craftsmanship, War, farming and others. To represent this, we add the devotions. They give bonuses in fields promoted by religion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a7e7a2593ef44bc7dfd8b7c4fc8ffbf9dd75e67b.png[/img]
The devotion is the level of influence those aspects will have in the life of your people.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/45cfff67f0cb2abf181dc4fbe9b0a30bcc1a8186.png[/img]
Some of the devotions.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/ef703b7702b4023179e37e11380da50a81924ee9.png[/img]
The devotion to agriculture.

----- Kings, vassals and vavasours -----

The Middles Ages is an era that saw countless evolution, the creation of a new power structure, the feudalism. It will change the structure of the armies, evolving from previous "professional army" to ban and levies more quickly assemble, but less qualified.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/a680cf90a9e776013ea69a677d96459944409f77.png[/img]

The vassals are the main elements of feudal society. They curtail the power of your central power, but in exchange, they will protect their lands, and so yours. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/f35fbfad90cb6860c867c87a33ff87e180bdaffd.png[/img]
The army changing in the levy, dependent on the quality of your castles and the power of your vassals.

They are unavoidable at the beginning of the Middle Ages but once the situation is stabilized you will need to curtail their influence to regain complete control of the state. In Middles Ages, your mean to control the vassal is to pay them through honorifics titles and court culture.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/e5ec7a56e19b3e4156c3c2e554c055a3abe33550.png[/img]
Nobility is the node that represents the effort to control the nobility.

Another important aspect of the Middle Ages is the mutation of the religion and the clergy position in society. The faith becomes more and more universalist in the Mediterranean Basin, and so became a, if not the major element of geopolitics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/45f5152d593ef16b81e35a5762d5e63e070de218.png[/img]
Holy Orders and Holy wars are one of the key aspects of this geopolitical religion.

It's also in this era that most of the oldest universities were built. This building will increase a lot of your capacity to conceptualize mathematics and philosophy. Soon it will become a centre of knowledge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/39eb406a33f22a07720bdd70afd17ed9506c622d.png[/img]
University and the research will increase the scientific knowledge, small at the beginning, but will grow as huge impact in both the civil sector...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/8d0e309218e6b02b46f7d0ad2767b1164b74d2ef.png[/img]
... And the military sector.

The economy of the Middle Ages was centred around corporation and the renewal of trade. It also saw the emergence of a banking system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/c85a1bac80f5daa084aa47eecaa90f81e81d57ad.png[/img]
You will have to defend the trade roads from highwayman to keep the trade and the money flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/51359f9714757beaf2083e591b5e1eea3edb375a.png[/img]
Banks permit a more flexible way to handle money, expanding way more the maximum of money permitted and allow the player to go in debt.

----- Overhaul -----

New starting location: Paris, use the fertile land around the seine to develop a powerful feudal kingdom.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/1f4305054f28cc65045c2d42f236a109c16970d1.png[/img]

The ability to zoom in and out and making a group without the mouse wheel. Just activate the option in the menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6db3dde969a490740ce9a6e2c2285251fec93653.png[/img]
Options are on the left side.

notes.title: End of january Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! we are proud to release another update on Orbi Universo! It's way larger than the previous one and improved the experience in many places.

First of all the most important: we have finally integrate the workshop, we will enjoy to see all your creations!

in term of localization, we are glad to support our Japanese fans by releasing a Japanese localization entirely made by a benevolent fan, Sunohara Yoshio, glory to him!

We also finally add a tooltip font support for Japanese, Korean, most of the Chinese character and Cyrillic alphabet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6eb8eaa4b8ec4178fa6648c8c6b448b36c4910b7.jpg[/img]

in more content-focused news, we add a new event "Mercenaries Uprising" if you don't pay your mercenaries they will revolt and your powerful civilization will end like Carthage.

There is a new starting location in the Andes, to let the Yucatan less alone in the Americas

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/bd083fd9a02665c268bd32955f97628f3f7f1cba.jpg[/img]

We also ease the experience in most field, we add a notification when a node removes a previous one

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/30a6ca5cc232560cd922e07cb46f85bfa437bebd.jpg[/img]

we also add an autosave system to make sure your civilization endure.

To ease the navigation in the menu you now can hide uninteresting node in the shop, you need to slide the node to the right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35390550/6dde8580f783669b04cefd7ac94a5326d30f68bd.png[/img]

Also, we made some fixes and minor balancing, like fixing French localization mistakes. and translated part of the interface that was not. 
after some debate with you, we change "Dark age" by "late antiquity" to avoid confusion with the end of the bronze age.

The coup d'etat event is a bit nerf to avoid an endless loop of coups.

We add a discord button in the main menu  and updated the EULA

and finally, we fix the group name bug when loading a save

The future of Orbi Universo

We are currently working one multiple things, first adding achievements. Still fixing bugs and trouble.
But we officially back on adding nodes and relations! The Middle age era is under development, but we can’t give you a release date for now

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
Hello to all of you first of all thanks to your support in our adventure! Even if we published the update yesterday, instability Steam prevents us from doing it sooner.

As promised, we are fixing some minor bugs, such as localization problems, and a minor error that prevents the feudal age from appearing correctly.
